  THURSDAY, JULY 11, 2024
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-53962  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, June 13, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-53995  Recommendation to discuss and review e-scooter rentals and private scooters to
  operate on the Beach Bike path for a 12-month pilot program.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-53963  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-53964  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-53968  Recommendation to review and discuss the Marine Advisory Commission’s regular
  meeting time and date; BYLAWS, ARTICLE Vl Meetings Section 1.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-53965  Recommendation to receive and file a "Point of Historical Interest"
  presentation recognizing Long Beach's importance to surfing history in Southern
  California.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

  6201 APPIAN WAY

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau at (562) 570-3215 by noon the
day prior to the meeting.
